senses.sense_definition: Samen met anderen aan een constructie of project werken.

examples.text: Verschillende aannemers zullen <w>meebouwen</w> aan de nieuwe wetenschapscampus.

target_lang_translations.en: Various contractors will <w>help build</w> the new science campus.

examples.text: Veel landen <w>bouwen</w> in Europa <w>mee</w> aan de nieuwe ruimtesonde.

target_lang_translations.en: Many countries in Europe are <w>helping to build</w> the new space probe.

target_lang_definitions.en: To work together with others on a construction or project.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for contributing to a construction project.

en.target_lang_word: to participate in the construction of
en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Formal term for being part of a building process.
Technical or collaborative term for building something together.
